info.title: PaqadHR API
info.description:
Welcome to the **PaqadHR**. 

PaqadHR is a multi-tenant Human Resource Management platform. All tenant-scoped endpoints follow the pattern `/api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/...`. Authentication uses JWT Bearer tokens or tenant API keys (`Bearer paq_...`). 

Tags are organized by feature area. Use the filter box above to search endpoints.
